## Overview & Business Heritage
Founded in Mumbai during the formative years of Corporate India, Jhaveri Bros. & Co. Pvt. Ltd. is one of India's oldest and most prestigious houses for recognition awards and corporate gifts. Over eleven decades of continuous stewardship, the firm has earned an unshakeable reputation for fine craftsmanship, personal attention, and commercial integrity.

## Six Core Product Collections
1. Corporate Gifts: Executive mementoes, desktop timepieces, personalized gifting articles, and commemorative keepsakes.
2. Cups, Medals & Shields: Tournament cups, cast medals with ribbons, and polished hardwood presentation shields for athletic and scholastic championships.
3. Plaques: Wall and desk citation plaques featuring etched brass, silver inlays, and rich solid hardwood backing.
4. Salvers: Mirror-polished ceremonial salvers and presentation trays with decorative borders.
5. Silver: Pure silver presentation trophies, divine embossed coins, marriage keepsake coins, and birth-record coins and spoons.
6. Trophies: Extensive design catalogue (>7,000 designs) spanning optical crystal, lead glass, precision acrylic, cast metals, and fine sculpted woods.

## Customization & Engraving Services
Jhaveri Bros. provides nine specialized personalization techniques tailored to specific materials and product requirements:
1. Laser Engraving (polymers, wood, coated metals, acrylic)
2. Pantograph Engraving (stylus-traced mechanical cutting for silver-plated bowls and cups)
3. Etching (chemical and acid resist etching on brass, stainless steel, stone, glass)
4. Embossing (tactile 3D dimensional relief on silver coins and presentation metals)
5. Screen Printing (precision stencil printing for multi-colour logos on flat substrates)
6. Sand Blasting (abrasive air etching creating frosted finishes on crystal and glass)
7. 3D Engraving (subsurface and relief dimensional portraits and sculptural models)
8. Sticker Application / Identification (metallic and coated adhesive markers for trophy pedestals)
9. Foil Engraving (gold or silver leaf paper engraving on presentation mounts)

## Verified Historical Milestones
- 1914: Late Shri Shyamdas Jhaveri founds Jhaveri Bros. in Mumbai, managing direct imports from England and Germany.
- Early 1960s: First in India to import Montblanc writing instruments, serving as its sole retailer then.
- 1981: Shri Durlabh Jhaveri acquires the distributorship of CROSS writing instruments, becoming its first distributor in Mumbai.
- 1982: Manufactured the World Hockey Cup awards and Himalayan Rallies trophies.
- Present: Administered by Seyjhal D. Jhaveri, continuing long-standing relationships with vendors (30+ years) and serving leading Indian institutions.

## Notable Clientele & Commissions
- Public & Legal: High Court of Bombay, Income Tax Department, BSNL.
- Financial & Banking: HDFC Bank, Exim Bank, LIC of India, Standard Chartered Bank, Deloitte Haskins & Sells.
- Corporate & Industrial: Mahindra, Larsen & Toubro, Indian Oil, Bharat Petroleum, HPCL, Clariant Chemicals, Tata Group, Reliance Industries, Lodha, Colliers, Ador Welding.
- Entertainment & Media: Shri Amitabh Bachchan, Dharma Productions, DRAFTFCB ULKA.
- Sports & Tournaments: Rugby India, Salil Ankola Benefit Match (2010), Dhanraj Pillai hockey awards.
